analyst.summary: Deepak Fertilisers & Petrochemicals makes technical ammonium nitrate, industrial/mining chemicals and specialty fertilisers, and its June 2026 quarter showed a sharp profit and margin improvement (profit roughly doubled versus the prior quarter) as a multi-year capacity expansion nears completion (93-96% done). Debt has risen to fund that expansion. We rate it a Hold: an encouraging inflection quarter in a cyclical, capital-intensive business that needs to be confirmed by at least one more quarter before we would get more constructive.
